description: BELGIUM. From a net monthly income, computes the capital a fixed-rate loan allows and the highest home price once the Region's purchase costs are paid. Belgium has no legal debt-to-income rule: the share of income (default 33%) and the rate (default 3.5%) are example assumptions you can change. As on payotte.com/belgium/borrowing-capacity (FR: /belgique/capacite-emprunt, NL: /belgie/leencapaciteit).

monthly_credits.description: Other monthly credit repayments, in euros (default 0).

municipality.description: Optional: a municipality Payotte covers (e.g. "Liège", "Gent", "Ixelles"), used to find the Region when region is omitted.

net_monthly_income.description: Household net income per month, in euros.

region.description: Region of the home. Registration duties are regional. May be omitted if municipality is given.

share_of_income_pct.description: Share of that income going to the loan, in percent (default 33).

sole_home.description: Sole and own home (you will live there and own no other home). Default true. False = normal rates.

name: borrowing_capacity_be
title: Belgian borrowing capacity and maximum home price
